citations.quote: Name: Fiddlesticks. Official role tags: Mage, Support.
Magic Damage per Tick:37.5 / 62.5 / 87.5 (+ 12.5% AP)
Active: Fiddlesticks channels, then blinks to the target location surrounded by a murder of crows, continually dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Channels before blinking into sustained nearby magic damage.

citations.quote: Passive: While Fiddlesticks has been out of combat for at least 2.25 seconds and is not visible to the enemy team, or is impersonating an Effigy, its damaging ability will additionally fear targets hit for a duration.

core_mechanics.summary: Damaging abilities can fear from an unseen, out-of-combat setup.

cards.purpose: Recognize Fiddlesticks' damage focus and ambush pattern.
cards.title: Fiddlesticks

citations.quote: The trinket slot can still be temporarily replaced by Eye of the Herald.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Eye of the Herald can temporarily replace the effigy trinket.

citations.quote: Innate: Fiddlesticks has a Scarecrow Effigy in place of a trinket, which will imitate Fiddlesticks.

core_mechanics.summary: Effigies replace the normal trinket and imitate Fiddlesticks.

citations.quote: Fiddlesticks can impersonate an effigy by remaining idle out of combat.

core_mechanics.summary: Fiddlesticks can impersonate an effigy while idle out of combat.

citations.quote: From level 6 onward, placing an Effigy also summons a Sweeper Drone at the location for 6 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Effigy placement summons a temporary Sweeper Drone from level 6.

cards.purpose: Recognize effigy deception and the unusual trinket replacement.
cards.title: A Harmless Scarecrow

citations.quote: There is a very brief grace period after Fiddlesticks becomes visible or enters combat during which Terrify's passive can remain active.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Brief fear eligibility can persist after entering vision or combat.

citations.quote: impersonating an effigy allows Bountiful Harvest and Reap to fear enemies even when seen.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Effigy impersonation allows Harvest and Reap to fear even while seen.

citations.quote: Passive: While Fiddlesticks has been out of combat for at least 2.25 seconds and is not visible to the enemy team, or is impersonating an Effigy, its damaging ability will additionally fear targets hit for a duration.

core_mechanics.summary: Unseen, out-of-combat casts or effigy impersonation enable ability fears.

citations.quote: Active: Fiddlesticks screeches at the target enemy, fearing them and dealing magic damage based on the target's current health.

core_mechanics.summary: The active targets an enemy with fear and current-health magic damage.

citations.quote: Targets feared by Fiddlesticks by any means cannot be affected by it again for a duration equal to Terrify's cooldown. Against these targets, Terrify's damage and minimum threshold are doubled.

core_mechanics.summary: Recent fear prevents repeat fear while doubling Terrify damage.

cards.purpose: Recognize fear setup and the recent-fear damage conversion.
cards.title: Terrify

citations.quote: Active: Fiddlesticks tethers to nearby enemies, channeling for a short duration during which it reveals tethered enemies and continually deals magic damage to them. Fiddlesticks heals for a portion of the damage dealt.

core_mechanics.summary: Channeled tethers reveal and damage enemies while healing Fiddlesticks.

citations.quote: If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the last tick deals increased magic damage based on each target's missing health and the remaining cooldown is reduced.

core_mechanics.summary: An uninterrupted finish adds missing-health damage and reduces the remaining cooldown.

citations.quote: The target does not have to be visible to be tethered by this ability.

core_mechanics.summary: Tether application does not require target visibility.

cards.purpose: Recognize the drain, healing and incentive to interrupt its finish.
cards.title: Bountiful Harvest

citations.quote: Active: Fiddlesticks slashes the target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit. Enemies hit in the center of the slash are also silenced.

core_mechanics.summary: An area slash damages and slows, with an additional silence in its center.

cards.purpose: Recognize the slash and avoid its center silence.
cards.title: Reap

citations.quote: Active: Fiddlesticks channels, then blinks to the target location surrounded by a murder of crows, continually dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Channels before blinking into sustained nearby magic damage.

citations.quote: Roots do not interrupt the ability despite being a movement channel.

core_mechanics.summary: Roots do not interrupt the channel.

cards.purpose: Recognize the delayed blink engage and persistent damage area.
cards.title: Crowstorm

factual_risks: Exact base cooldowns are absent; important cooldown topics are retained in card metadata.
Detailed fear grace periods, monster-specific conditions, item interactions and impersonation exceptions are omitted from central teaching.

relationships.condition: Terrify's passive fear conditions are satisfied.

section_disposition.reason: Basic attack projectile and close-range behavior are secondary to the central spell recognition plan.
Effigy replacement, impersonation and later Sweeper Drone placement are combined on the passive card.
Passive fear, targeted fear and recent-fear damage are combined on the Q card.
Drain, reveal, healing, finishing damage and cooldown refund are combined on the W card.
Area slow and center silence are combined on the E card.
Channeled blink, sustained area damage and root interaction are taught on the R card.

summary: An overview and primary ability cards teach effigy deception, conditional fear, channeled healing, center silence and Crowstorm ambushes. Related conditional effects remain merged into their primary abilities.
